# Hello

> Checks that Gradatim works in this host, from the install to the steps every skill shares. Use when the user asks for Gradatim's hello check, or whether Gradatim works here.

| | |
|---|---|
| Skill | `hello`, [its file](../../skills/hello/SKILL.md) |
| Step | none: it runs at any time |
| Call it | `/gradatim:hello` on Claude Code; [the other hosts](install.md#calling-a-skill) |

## When to use it

- The user asks for Gradatim's hello check, or whether Gradatim works here.
- Not for starting a project: that is [`init-project`](init-project.md). Not for where a project stands: that is [`method`](method.md).

## What it reads and writes

| Document | Path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Agent file | `AGENTS.md` | reads |

It also reads the host's map and one of the method's own files. It writes nothing.
